hypothesis: Calibrated multi-sensor ridge uncertainty plus exact expected-DTI placement can reduce redundant picks.
mechanism: Buffered spatial OOF isotonic probabilities; >=32 provenance-checked model truth draws; exact mean-gain add/backward prune.
non_fault_mimic: Differential erosion along lithologic contacts can align topographic and magnetic ridges without fault slip.

holdout.reason: Universal registry blocker triggered before model fitting or candidate placement.

note: Expected-DTI lane stopped: a registry prior blocks every nonempty dot set under the 3-pixel literal overlap rule.
limitation: No production TIFF created. Synthetic unit-test TIFFs are serialization fixtures only and never published.

active_method_lane.name: expected-DTI-optimal selection
active_method_lane.calibration: Isotonic regression on spatially blocked, buffered out-of-fold predictions.
active_method_lane.selection: Greedy exact mean DTI marginal gain over plausible truth draws, followed by backward pruning until marginal gain is nonpositive.
active_method_lane.incumbent_comparison: Spacing/MCLP on the same calibrated surface and folds; promotion requires improvement greater than two paired spatial block-bootstrap standard errors.
active_method_lane.leakage_canary: Test every feature alone; AUC above 0.90 is leakage until explained.
active_method_lane.status_note: No cache bytes, buffered OOF predictions, model checkpoints, or production candidate are available.

hypothesis_details.physical_signature: Weak, spatially coherent cross-sensor ridge/edge agreement with positional uncertainty; test for subtle or partly buried fault extensions.
hypothesis_details.rationale_for_uncatalogued_fault: Independent topographic and potential-field ridges may jointly preserve weak structural continuation not represented by the surface-fault catalogue; this is a hypothesis, not evidence.
hypothesis_details.novelty_rationale: The cached channels have appeared in sibling work; global feature novelty is not claimed. The proposed intervention is calibrated exact-DTI selection, and duplicate checks are blocked by the universal registry witness.
hypothesis_details.qualitative_expected_benefit: Highest relative opportunity among the in-lane shortlist; numerical DTI benefit is unknown and not projected.
hypothesis_details.implementation_cost: Medium if cache/OOF is restored; currently blocked before experiment.

source_screen.scope: Official/public catalog metadata and one coarse index query only; no external geological data files downloaded or integrated.

synthetic_threshold_check.isolated_unit_case: Threshold q > alpha*S gives positive exact gain above the threshold and negative gain below it.
synthetic_threshold_check.general_finite_spatial_dti: Not a universal exact rule; the kernel-redundancy and finite-expectation counterexamples reject naive thresholding.
synthetic_threshold_check.decision: Use exact mean marginal DTI over plausible truth rasters; no competition surface was evaluated.
